title: China's K-Beauty Market Rebalances as Functional Skincare Outpaces Traditional Categories
summary: China\'s appetite for Korean beauty products showed diverging trends across categories in October 2026, with growth concentrated in functional skincare and premium complexion products, while traditionally strong segments such as sheet masks and sun care continued to lose momentum.According to Beauty
